fusions.name: Scattered Slivers
fusions.desc: Sprays a shoal of iron slivers in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 11 damage to each enemy caught and leaving it [Sundered] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Sounding Line
fusions.desc: Casts a weighted iron line at an enemy up to 8 tiles away, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour.

fusions.name: Slick Plate
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 15% and your dodge chance by 10% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Each Slip a Rivet
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
